name: Alvor (Ria de Alvor)
notes: Summer W-SW sea breeze side-on; tidal currents near the ria mouth. Approximate position.

name: Fuseta (Ria Formosa)
notes: Lagoon flat water in W-SW thermal; shallow at low tide, strong tidal flow in channels. Approximate position.

name: Praia de Faro
notes: Ocean side of Ilha de Faro; W-SW summer sea breeze side-shore. Swimmers in summer. Approximate position.

name: Cabedelo (Figueira da Foz)
notes: Summer N nortada side-shore; Atlantic swell, cold water, currents near the Mondego mouth. Approximate position.

name: Praia de Ofir (Esposende)
notes: Summer N nortada side-shore; open Atlantic beach, rocks offshore, cold water. Approximate position.

name: Lagoa de Santo André
notes: Coastal lagoon flat water in summer N nortada; level depends on the sea opening. Approximate position.

name: Zahara de los Atunes
notes: Poniente W side-on; Levante blows side-off here and is not rated. Summer bathing zones. Approximate position.

name: Valdelagrana (El Puerto de Santa María)
notes: Bay of Cádiz beach; Poniente W onshore. Levante offshore. Summer kite zone rules. Approximate position.

name: Cabo de Gata (Playa de San Miguel)
notes: Poniente SW-W side-on; Levante is side-off on this shore. Long open beach. Approximate position.

name: Playa de la Misericordia (Málaga)
notes: Levante E and Poniente W side-shore; terral N wind is offshore. Busy city beach in summer. Approximate position.

name: El Pinet (Santa Pola)
notes: E-SE sea breeze onshore, NE side-shore; W poniente offshore. Kite zone outside bathing season. Approximate position.

name: El Saler (Valencia)
notes: Summer E sea breeze onshore; W poniente offshore. Dune protected area, use marked access. Approximate position.

name: Castelldefels
notes: Kiting mainly outside summer bathing season; S-SW garbí onshore. N wind offshore. Approximate position.

name: Sa Ràpita (Mallorca)
notes: S-SW summer sea breeze onshore; N tramuntana offshore. Kite zone rules in summer. Approximate position.

name: Playa de Muro (Bay of Alcúdia)
notes: NE-E sea breeze onshore in bay; W-SW offshore. Kiting restricted to zones in summer. Approximate position.

name: El Cotillo Lagoons (Fuerteventura)
notes: Sheltered lagoons; N wind side-shore. NE trade blows side-off here and is not rated. Reef, tide. Approximate position.

name: Playa de Somo (Cantabria)
notes: NE summer breeze and NW fronts side-on; S wind offshore. Surf beach, swell and currents. Approximate position.

name: Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer (Plage Est)
notes: SE-SW marin and sea breeze onshore; Mistral NW is offshore. Long Camargue beach. Approximate position.

name: Plage Napoléon (Port-Saint-Louis-du-Rhône)
notes: Shallow water in E-SE and SW winds; Mistral NW offshore. Gulf of Fos shipping nearby. Approximate position.

name: Le Barcarès
notes: E marin onshore; Tramontane NW is offshore here, ride the Leucate lagoon instead. Approximate position.

name: Lido de Sète (Villeroy)
notes: SE marin and SW sea breeze side-on; Tramontane NW offshore. Long sandy lido. Approximate position.

name: Poetto (Cagliari)
notes: Scirocco SE and SW side-on; Mistral NW offshore. Kite corridor at the Quartu end. Approximate position.

name: Chia (Su Giudeu)
notes: Scirocco SE and W winds; Mistral NW side-off and not rated. Protected dunes, summer swimmers. Approximate position.

name: Putzu Idu (Sinis)
notes: Mistral NW side-shore; Capo Mannu wave spot nearby for experts. Rocks at bay ends. Approximate position.

name: Torre Canne (Puglia)
notes: Maestrale NW side-shore, NE onshore; SW offshore. Rocky patches along shore. Approximate position.

name: Punta Prosciutto (Porto Cesareo)
notes: Ionian side; W-NW maestrale side-on, S scirocco onshore. Marine reserve rules apply. Approximate position.

name: Tombolo della Giannella (Orbetello)
notes: Libeccio SW and Maestrale NW side-on; SE offshore. Long sandy tombolo, summer kite zones. Approximate position.

name: Halikounas (Corfu)
notes: Summer NW meltemi side-shore by Korission lagoon; E wind offshore. Remote beach. Approximate position.

name: Afiartis (Chicken Bay, Karpathos)
notes: Strong NW meltemi is side-off here; gust stays conservative and rates it offshore. Gusty, rescue needed. Approximate position.

name: Ammoudara (Heraklion, Crete)
notes: Summer N-NW meltemi onshore; S wind offshore. Hotel beach, swimmers in summer. Approximate position.

name: Monolithi (Preveza)
notes: Long Ionian beach; summer W-NW thermal onshore, E wind offshore. Approximate position.

name: Tourlida (Mesolongi)
notes: Causeway into the lagoon with shallow flat water in summer thermals. Shore facing varies. Approximate position.

name: Kilyos (Istanbul)
notes: Black Sea beach; NE poyraz onshore, S lodos offshore. Swell and currents. Approximate position.

name: Lady's Mile (Limassol)
notes: E-SE winds onshore; W thermal is offshore on this shore. Akrotiri military area nearby. Approximate position.

name: Mellieħa Bay (Għadira)
notes: NE gregale and NW onshore in winter; SW offshore. Bathing zone in summer. Approximate position.

name: Shkorpilovtsi
notes: Long Black Sea beach; NE and SE winds onshore, W offshore. Approximate position.

name: Kranevo
notes: Black Sea beach north of Varna; NE winds onshore, W offshore. Busy in summer. Approximate position.

name: Mamaia Nord (Năvodari)
notes: Black Sea; NE and SE winds onshore, W offshore. Busy resort beach in summer. Approximate position.
